prompt: Set up site-src/ so any coding agent behaves the same in it. Write the rules file and add guardrails where they earn their place. Local only.

checks.desc: a CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md was written

rubric: Writes the working rules at the top of CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md
Adds map sections only where grounded in the repo (e.g. generated pages vs sources, the deploy branch)
Any guardrail it installs actually runs here (e.g. the repo's unittest suite) and it shows it running
Invents no commands the repo does not have
